results.content:
Search, enrich, and resolve identities across billions people through one API.

TL;DR: Ploid gives your product or agent live, accurate data on any person. You can search, enrich, find emails and phones, social media, and match identities across 2B+ people with one API, CLI or MCP.

Hey everyone! We're Emmanuel Hernandez and Kamran Karic from Ploid .

(Platform: Creating a Dataset)

(Playground: Submitting a Search API Request) [...] (Playground: Submitting a Search API Request)

Why did we built this? We noticed the same problem everywhere: people's data was either outdated, scattered across the internet, too expensive, or incredibly difficult to access. This made it hard for companies to build great products and deliver accurate results to their customers. What stood out to us was that almost every data provider was building for humans, especially sales and GTM teams, but almost no one was building for AI agents. We believe agents are the future, and they need reliable, up-to-date information about people to actually do their jobs well. [...] So we started building Ploid. We became obsessed with collecting, connecting, and making people's data accessible at scale. What started as a simple idea has grown into a database of over 2 billion people, making Ploid one of the largest people-data platforms in the world. And we're just getting started.

What Ploid does

Who uses it? Companies that rely on people's data to power their products and services. From sales and recruiting platforms to customer intelligence and AI agents, they depend on accurate, up-to-date information about people to deliver better results to their customers.

results.title: Ploid — The Living Index of People
results.content:
# Frontier people search over every human

## Use Ploid with your agent

Traditional data providers expect the interaction to be static. You check the query boxes, export a CSV, and spend your afternoon formatting and cleaning what comes back. They're built to sell you records, and most of what they sell was true days ago, sometimes months ago.

Ploid is a frontier data company that does the heavy lifting for you. It maintains a living index of over two billion people from every source they show up in on the internet, built directly for agents to reason over the full picture of a person.

The data layer agents were missing. [...] The data layer agents were missing.

1. Ploid has created the first Superprofile. Derived from professional profiles across the internet and connected through a proprietary system that links social, professional, and personal sites into one profile.
2. Reasoning over text, image, and video. Ploid lets agents read across every format — posts, photos, talks, interviews — and pull out the signals that don't live in a database field. The result is context you can act on in the real world.
3. Ploid works where you already are. Use Ploid inside , , , , and every other platform or agent with MCP or CLI support. One index, available to every agent you already trust theres no migration or new interface.

## Everything you need to find and understand people [...] ## Everything you need to find and understand people

One evidence-backed surface for people search, identity resolution, company research, and enrichment. Use the part you need.

### Search

Describe who you're looking for and get back a list of matching people instantly. Search by role, company, skills, location, or anything else.

`POST /v1/search`Search docs →

## Start in minutes

Call the API, run the CLI, or connect the MCP server to the agent you already use.

`curl  \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $PLOID_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "query": "software engineers at fintech companies in San Francisco", "num_results": 25 }'`

One request returns up to 150 matching people.Search API reference →
